description: glossary.md has malformed duplicate headings — '### **Minimum Read Version**' immediately followed by a bare '## Minimum Read Version (MRV)...' (lines ~189-213; same for MVCC and OCC) — which breaks the anchor scheme every other entry uses. Separately, verify entries that may describe retired designs: 'Tag Coverage' (mapping of which logs store which range tags — current routing is golden-ratio ShardRouter over sorted log ids with replication spanning all logs), 'Storage Team', 'Version Gap', and 'Manifest' (currently described as 'a configuration file... for service discovery'; the code's Manifest is the worker manifest carrying cluster/id/worker/params).
title: Glossary hygiene: malformed headings and unverified entries
